name: panel
description: A panel that slides over the page, pushes history, and closes with Back: keep-this, mood edit, install, the crisis resource. On desktop split pages it sits in the second column.

places.block: an object in the panel: the page gutter; between the rules on a split page
places.actions: its action row (a cluster): --s4 by --s7 apart, --s7 below

states.loading: n/a: a container shows its contents
states.empty: n/a: a panel always has content

a11y.role: region (or dialog where it is modal), named by its heading

responsive.1200: beside the title block; in a split page, the sticky second column (legacy context .page.split)

changelog.change: Slot foot: the closing row (04-ask's source panel). Pages round 3.
The Aside fixture shows a text, not an excerpt: excerpt retired with Ask's source panel (v4 C2).
The tag option (aside) and the foot slot: Ask's source panel used them until v4 C2; nothing does now. keybox and text leave uses with the Aside fixture.
